text: Fix stale `.phase-column` selectors in list-view e2e specs
description: 8 Playwright tests (navigation.spec.ts ×2, regression.spec.ts ×5, subphase-navigation.spec.ts ×1) wait on `.phase-column`, a class that no longer exists in src, so they time out regardless of behavior. Update selectors to the current Column.vue/ColumnsView.vue markup and get the suite green so list-view navigation refactors have real e2e coverage. Run with `npx playwright test --project=chromium` (reuses the running dev server on :4000; specs seed temp projects).

status.comment: Committed in a69ec9f. All 16 non-graph chromium e2e specs pass against the running dev server (:4000).

reflection: Verified: `npx playwright test --project=chromium --grep-invert graph` → 16 passed. Scope grew past the selector: `.modal`→`.modal-panel`, strict `.project-path`, post-creation follow-up prompts (new finishIdeaCreation helper in e2e/test-utils.ts), l/h key model changed (l expand then step in; j never descends since ≥2026-02), creation-modal search results now `.result-item` and click submits. None of these were app bugs; all were test drift. Graph spec left unchanged — split into its own idea.
